_comment: Gate registry for new-gate attribution (design §5a). Read by the version-delta banner (hooks/banner.py) to ANNOUNCE a gate as new when its `since` falls in the (last_seen, current] range a repo crosses, and by the Stop hook (bin/prawduct-hook cmd_stop) to ATTRIBUTE a blocking message to the version + gate that caused it. `since` is the plugin version that introduced the gate; foundational gates that predate semver versioning carry `1.0.0`. This file ships inside the plugin, so adding a gate (and its attribution) creates no diff in any consuming repo. Release process: when a release adds an enforcing gate, append it here with `since` = that release's version, so the banner announces it on the bump and blocking messages flag it NEW.

gates.name: reflection
gates.summary: a session reflection must be captured before session end

gates.summary: Critic review is required for each chunk built against a plan
